about_the_game:
Main Plot

As an ordinary office worker, after finishing a busy day at work, I finally looked forward to an exciting holiday team-building trip with my colleagues! The plan was to escape to the countryside and immerse ourselves in nature, but fate had a cruel twist in store—our plane crashed midway, and the survivors, including you, drifted to an unfamiliar island.

On this island, you encountered a hospitable indigenous tribe who generously took you in, allowing you to start a new life on this uncharted land. At first, life was peaceful and serene, as if everything had returned to the most primitive rhythm of nature. However, as time passed, the island began to reveal its hidden secrets, and beneath the calm surface, undercurrents started to stir...

You will face countless mysteries and challenges, and every choice you make could alter your destiny. Will you uncover the truth behind the island, or will you live out an entirely different life on this land? The final decision lies in your hands. Embark on this journey filled with unknowns and adventures, and experience a holiday life like no other!

Gameplay

  • Simulation & Management: Develop your farm through agricultural activities and harvest unique crops.

  • Role-Playing: Collaborate with colleagues (also survivors) to adapt modern skills to tribal life.

  • Mini-Game Collection: Labyrinth puzzles, Coral Bead Relay, and Prospector's Challenge.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.

short_description: You are an ordinary office worker who embarks on a company summer retreat, only for the plane to crash en route to a countryside getaway, stranding you in a primitive tribe. Work with locals to build your ideal rural life.
